name: Iron Reapers
headerMeta: Golden era · Special melee infantry (dual weapon) · Blob/flank · 270 leadership · Honour Unit
pitch: A press-one-button burst blob that cycles a CC-immune weapon-swap window and a heavy-armour damage-reduction passive to break blocking units and shield walls. It dies to kiting, heavy burst, and debuffs that land before the passive resets — proper positioning beats it before its own cooldowns do.

doctrines.name: Linebreaker Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Every 3 attacks: block-break boost vs enemy units, 2s.

doctrines.name: Epic Combat Doctrine
doctrines.effect: After every 3 attacks: next attack's DMG +11%. Every 6 attacks: restores 15% max HP. Every 9 attacks: 2.5s CC immunity.

doctrines.name: Movement Speed After Hit
doctrines.effect: Filler per Amya guide; speed increases DPS because 20-30% of fight time is spent walking to the next auto-attack target.
doctrines.note: 20–30% of fight time is spent walking to the next auto-attack target — speed indirectly raises DPS

veterancy.label: Middle Line to +1-target node, rest Bottom
veterancy.body: +14 points into Middle Line, stopping at the point that grants +1 target per strike; remaining points into Bottom Line.

battleRole.positioning: X-move in and let the heavy-armour passive build (wait for a CC or a few hits before pressing Tiger Step). {1} Stay in melee contact with your hero to chain ability resets — X+V while the hero stays close. {1} Charge has two swings and ignores block, so give it half a second on contact before activating Tiger Step rather than popping it instantly. {2}
battleRole.formation: Dispersed formation to spread the sword hit-box across up to 8 targets when engaging a wide area. {2} Stack tight against tower-shield/high-flat-defence blockers (e.g. Imperial Spear Guard) — Tiger Step's CC immunity offsets the usual flanking risk of a tight formation, no weapon swap needed. {2} Against isolated/narrow targets, charge dispersed, delay Tiger Step until the flanking models pass the target, then swap swords so the non-contact models hit its rear for double damage. {2}
battleRole.tips: Tiger Step (skill 2) carries undocumented CC immunity and isn't cancelled by movement orders or weapon swaps for its 12s duration — usable offensively to commit or defensively to pull the unit out of a cavalry charge without being knocked down. {2} Heavy trait: 8-hit bonus damage reduction per model, reset by Charge or Tiger Step — press early if CC is incoming. {1} C-cancel (press C right after an enemy auto-attack) resets the animation and improves trades vs Stalwart or Claymore. {1} The heavy trait also mitigates artillery (treb counts as artillery) — Charge to tank a Trebuchet shot if the trait isn't currently active. {1} House Q&A flags it "safe to doctrine up" alongside Queen's Knights, Liao's Rangers, and Symmachean Stalwarts. {3}

matchups.pressure: You pressure: any block/shield-wall unit; house guidance pairs it with Full Mastery Rattan Pikes and/or MMAs as a strong combination, and calls it near-full-bottom-line for Territory Wars wall-pushing {4}.

controls.notes: Charge (two swings, ignores block) → swap weapon (swords for spread, flails for single-target) → Tiger Step (12s CC immunity, uncancellable by movement/weapon-swap) → sustain with C-cancelled auto-attacks to reset the heavy-armour passive. {1}{2} Basic rotation: charge, swap to swords, activate Tiger Step, then decide to fully commit or pull out before it ends. {2} 1v1/anti-block burst line: flails in, charge to prevent sidestep, swap to swords and click Tiger Step to skip the swap animation, then leave it to fight until the target dies — only worth it versus a blocking unit or when you can kill fast. {1}

gaps: Formation guidance uses tight/dispersed descriptors from the transcript only — no F1/F2 naming sourced for this unit.

StarBurst's house card (2024-09-16) has icon-embedded gaps in Doctrine 2's text, and Doctrine 3 cuts off mid-sentence at 'Every 9' - incomplete coverage for full doctrine optimization. House build data is normally the more trusted source here, but neither it nor Amya's guide addresses the latest patch's Leadership/Health/artillery-resist changes.
Tiger Step's duration is stated as '12 seconds' consistently across sources, but nobody's confirmed it against the actual in-game tooltip yet.
Exact cooldown and damage numbers here are approximate - they come from a paraphrased video summary, so cross-check the Amya guide if you need precision.
Mastery tree allocation is shown as a 'planned' or 'strong setup' variant (unclear whether it's live or just tested), and both capstones are unallocated in the screenshot we have.

Cross-unit mentions (Silahdars, Rattan Viper Archers, Ironcap Swordsmen guides) place Iron Reapers as a comparison/threat benchmark from 2020-2022 footage predating the current patch — useful color but not vet-checked against current balance.
